---
name: A response to a finding
about: Tell us a finding was fixed, declined, or wrong
title: "anoieu <id>: "
labels: response
---

<!-- The protocol is one line. Everything else is optional. -->

anoieu <id>: fixed | declined | wrong -- <one sentence>

<!--
  fixed     the change has landed or is in review
  declined  real, and you are choosing to live with it -- the reason is worth
            more to us than the fix would have been
  wrong     the analysis is mistaken; tell us what it assumed that is not true,
            and we will narrow the check

  A link to where the work was discussed is more useful than a summary of it.
  See docs/workflows.md for the whole arrangement.
-->
